line.name: K-Star Road: Galleria West (Gangnam-dol house) → Apgujeong Rodeo Station → Seolleung-ro lanes → Cheongdam crossing (갤러리아 명품관 WEST → 압구정로데오역 → 청담사거리), 1.0 km

segments.label: K-Star Road main line, Galleria West to Cheongdam crossing (pedestrian router on OSM streets)

more_lines.name: Branch to Dosan Park: Rodeo Station → Seolleung-ro 157/155-gil → Apgujeong-ro 46-gil → Dosan Park (도산공원 방향), 1.0 km
Cheongdam lanes: Figure Museum W → Seolleung-ro 158-gil → Cheongdam-gol (선릉로158길 · 청담골)

pins.name: Start – Galleria West and the Gangnam-dol house (갤러리아백화점 명품관 WEST · 강남돌하우스)
pins.desc: The K-Star Road starts here: the Gangnam-dol house in front of Galleria West, where the giant K-pop character toys stand for photos. Gangnam-gu runs the project to show visitors the stars' favourite shops and spots.

pins.name: Apgujeong Rodeo Station, Bundang line (압구정로데오역)
pins.desc: Suin-Bundang line. Exit 5 or 6 for Galleria and the Rodeo street; open toilets inside the station.

pins.name: Apgujeong Rodeo Street (압구정로데오거리)
pins.desc: The fashion and café street west of the station: boutiques, brunch places and late-night bars, busiest after 17:00.

pins.name: Zone B – Figure Museum W (피규어뮤지엄 W)
pins.desc: Figure and art-toy museum on Seolleung-ro 158-gil, with a shop. Tue to Sun 11:00 to 19:00, closed Mondays; adult ticket about ₩15,000 per the Gangnam-gu K-Star Road page.

pins.name: Zone B – Cheongdam-gol, the 18-year Korean set-meal house (청담골)
pins.desc: The Gangnam-gu K-Star Road list names this home-style restaurant on Seolleung-ro 148-gil: Mon to Fri 10:30 to 22:30, weekends to 22:00. Set meals around ₩8,000 to ₩12,000 on the official page. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Zone A – Horim Museum Sinsa branch (호림박물관 신사분관)
pins.desc: Museum of Korean art on Dosan-daero, one of the official Zone A spots.

pins.name: Zone A – CGV Cheongdam Cine City (CGV 청담씨네시티)
pins.desc: Cinema complex on Dosan-daero, a Zone A landmark; open toilets in the building.

pins.name: Zone A – Dosan Park (도산공원)
pins.desc: Neighbourhood park in memory of the independence leader Ahn Chang-ho, with an exhibition hall and a shaded lawn; the quiet end of the walk.

pins.name: End – Cheongdam crossing (청담사거리)
pins.desc: Official end of the K-Star Road main line. K-pop agency buildings stand around the crossing. They are working offices: photograph from the pavement and keep voices down.

pins.name: Yeongdong Bridge south junction (영동대교 남단 교차로)
pins.desc: Optional extension: walk on to Yeongdong Bridge and the Han River park for the sunset view.

pins.name: Toilet – Apgujeong Rodeo Station (압구정로데오역 개방화장실)
pins.desc: Open toilet in the Bundang-line station, next to the start.

pins.name: Toilet – Apgujeong lifelong learning centre (압구정평생학습관 개방화장실)
pins.desc: Open toilet at the community centre, 400 m west of the station towards Dosan Park.

pins.name: Toilet – Dosan Park, accessible (도산공원 장애인용화장실)
pins.desc: Accessible public toilet at the park.

pins.name: Toilet – CGV Cheongdam Cine City (씨네시티 개방화장실)
pins.desc: Open toilet in the cinema building on Dosan-daero.

pins.name: Toilet – Cheongdam Culture Centre (청담문화센터 개방화장실)
pins.desc: Open toilet at the community centre, 200 m east of Cheongdam crossing.

pins.name: Guillaume Cheongdam – dessert café (기욤 청담점)
pins.desc: Patisserie café on Seolleung-ro 152-gil, a queue-worthy stop between the Rodeo station and Cheongdam. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Bashe Coffee Cheongdam flagship (바샤커피 청담 플래그십 스토어)
pins.desc: Flagship of the Scandinavian-German coffee house on Apgujeong-ro, on the K-Star Road line. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Standard Bread Dosan – bakery café (스탠다드브레드 도산)
pins.desc: Popular bakery café near Dosan Park. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Iyaiya & Friends Dosan – brunch (이야이야앤프렌즈 도산)
pins.desc: Two-floor brunch café near Dosan Park. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Tartine Bakery Cheongdam (타르틴베이커리 청담점)
pins.desc: Bakery café on the lane behind the Rodeo street. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Shabu in Seoul – shabu-shabu (샤브인서울 압구정로데오점)
pins.desc: Shabu-shabu restaurant in the Rodeo lanes, one of the most reviewed places on the walk. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Hippo Apgujeong Rodeo – Vietnamese (힙포 압구정로데오 본점)
pins.desc: Vietnamese restaurant a few minutes west of the station. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Cheongdam Makoto – Japanese (청담 마코토)
pins.desc: Japanese restaurant on Apgujeong-ro 80-gil near the Cheongdam end. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Osteria Eden – Italian brunch (오스테리아 에덴)
pins.desc: Italian restaurant and brunch place on Seolleung-ro 152-gil. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.

pins.name: Cheongdam Haejeong – Korean (청담해정)
pins.desc: Korean restaurant next to the Cheongdam crossing. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-22.
